sources_considered.why: NVIDIA's own technical account of the August 2025 demonstrations discussed in the post; includes successful attacks, a blocked attempt, and mitigation conditions.
Secondary coverage was unnecessary once the researchers' technical account was available.

evidence_items.locator: How to plant the prompt injection — Anthropic Computer Use Agent demonstration
evidence_items.explanation: NVIDIA describes an August Black Hat demonstration in which a malicious issue redirected a computer-use agent into executing an attacker command, and a separate Cursor dependency-installation route that also granted remote control. Cursor blocked the initial direct injection, and the report makes autonomous execution and insufficient isolation central conditions of the successful attacks.

unresolved_gaps: The report does not provide a representative attack-success rate or a controlled estimate of how much each additional level of autonomy increases risk.
It demonstrates severe compromise capability, not industry-wide chaos or a count of destructive incidents.
